Package photos48.model

Class Photo

java.lang.Object
photos48.model.Photo
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Photo extends Object implements Serializable
Photo model represents a single photo in the system. Each photo is uniquely identified by a UUID and stores: - path: absolute filesystem path (for user imports) or relative path (for stock photos) - caption: user-provided description - dateTime: extracted from file last-modified time, truncated to seconds precision - tags: user-added tags with type and value Photo edits (caption, tags) are reflected everywhere the photo appears across albums.
Version:
1.0
Author:
